```{r}
#| label: setup-site
#| include: false
#| cache: false

# Install/load packages if needed
if (!requireNamespace("showtext", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("showtext")
}
if (!requireNamespace("ggplot2", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("ggplot2")
}

library(showtext)
library(ggplot2)

# Add three Google Fonts
# Arguments: font family name, Google Font name
font_add_google("Roboto Condensed", "Roboto Condensed")
font_add_google("Lato", "Lato")
font_add_google("Alegreya", "Alegreya")

# Tell R to use showtext for all subsequent plots
showtext_auto()

# Optional: set DPI for raster devices (adjust if you need high-res PNGs)
showtext_opts(dpi = 300)

# Set a site-wide ggplot theme using the loaded fonts
ggplot2::theme_set(
  ggplot2::theme_bw(
    base_size = 14,
    base_family = "Roboto Condensed"
  )
)

## Set the ggplot theme
theme_madhatter <- function(base_size = 10, exhibit = TRUE) {
  th <- ggplot2::theme_bw(base_size = base_size) +
    ggplot2::theme(
      plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(t = 1, r = 2, b = 1, l = 1, unit = "cm"),
      axis.title = ggplot2::element_text(
        family = "Roboto Condensed",
        size = 10
      ),
      axis.text = ggplot2::element_text(
        family = "Roboto Condensed",
        size = 8
      ),
      legend.text = ggplot2::element_text(
        family = "Roboto Condensed",
        size = 6
      ),
      legend.title = ggplot2::element_text(
        family = "Alegreya",
        size = 8
      ),
      plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(
        family = "Alegreya",
        size = 14,
        face = "bold"
      ),
      plot.title.position = "plot",
      plot.subtitle = ggplot2::element_text(
        family = "Alegreya",
        size = 10
      ),
      plot.caption = ggplot2::element_text(
        family = "Alegreya",
        size = 6
      ),
      plot.caption.position = "plot"
    )}

## Set the theme for all plots
ggplot2::theme_set(theme_madhatter())

## Update the fonts for geoms as well!
ggplot2::update_geom_defaults(geom = "text", new = list(
  family = "Roboto Condensed",
  face = "plain",
  size = 3.5,
  color = "#2b2b2b"
)
)
ggplot2::update_geom_defaults(geom = "label", new = list(
  family = "Roboto Condensed",
  face = "plain",
  size = 3.5,
  color = "#2b2b2b"
)
)

```
